chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from one of his companions, from Muḥammad ibn al-Muthannā al-Ḥaḍramī, from Muḥammad ibn Buhlūl ibn Muslim al-ʿAbdī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the believer is at the status of the scale’s pan: whenever there is an increase in his iman, there is an increase in his affliction.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer; one characterized by true faith
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: at the rank or status of; likened to

ai.seo_question: Why do a believer’s afflictions increase as his faith grows?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the mu'min is tested in proportion to the growth of his iman. As faith becomes weightier and stronger, afflictions also increase, reflecting the believer’s spiritual station and trial.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his companions, from Muhammad Bin Al Musanna Al Hazramy, from Muhammad Bin Bahloul Bin Muslim Al Abdy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘But rather, the Momin is at the status of the hand of the scale. Every time his Emān increases, there is an increase in his afflictions’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu‘Abd Allah from certain individuals of his people from Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna al-Hazrami from Muhammad ibn Bahlul ibn Muslim al-‘Abdi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The believers are like the two sides of a balance, as his belief increases in strength, his trial also increases in intensity.”
